t.zh: 到这里，数列都由测试交来。这一回没有输入，却要交出无穷多项：3, 5, 7, 9, …，每一项比上一项多 2。
t.en: So far every sequence has come from the test. This time there is no input, yet must give infinitely many terms: 3, 5, 7, 9, …, each 2 more than the one before.

t.zh: 固定的 2 由新元件<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>给出，它每一拍都交出设定的数。
t.en: A fixed 2 comes from a new part, <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>, which gives the number it is set to every tick.

after.zh: 首项加上「怎样由上一项算出这一项」，整个数列就定了：这叫递推。
after.en: A first term plus how each term comes from the one before fixes the whole sequence: this is a recurrence.

brief.zh: 交出首项 3、之后每项比上一项多 2 的数列。
brief.en: Give the sequence that starts at 3, each term 2 more than the one before.

hint.zh: 寄存卡里该存的，是下一拍要交出的那一项。
hint.en: What the register should hold is the term to give on the next tick.

hint.zh: 首项写在读寄存卡的初值上。
hint.en: The first term goes on the register’s start value.
